settings.objective: CE + 0.1 self-generated repeated-fourgram UL every10updates + 1.0 causal repeated-fourgram completion unlikelihood within past64 completion positions on unique non-special candidates excluding the true next token; same raw targets + 0.3 EOS auxiliary only at original unmasked standalone-newline human TRAIN true utterance ends; exclude only competing original newline main CE with original valid-target denominator retained

humanUtteranceEndEos.eligibility: human-chat TRAIN only; true utterance-end target is original standalone newline16; originally unmasked; no compound newline tokens
humanUtteranceEndEos.normalization: Sum auxiliary EOS CE / original nonmasked target count in same batch

originalNewlineCeAtEligibleEnds.eligibility: Exactly the existing human utterance-end EOS mask; original standalone-newline16 targets only

sequenceUnlikelihood.prefixSelection: Human first sampled row: latest existing token-aligned true after-utterance separator within8..32 original real tokens, provided clean character start; otherwise original min32. All nonhuman rows unchanged. No retokenization or RNG.
sequenceUnlikelihood.normalization: sum repeated generated-target penalties / all generated positions
sequenceUnlikelihood.dropoutRng: fork_rng CPU; restore global CE dropout RNG and model mode

settings.initialization: Our Round28 latest model + AdamW moments + Torch/Python RNG; hold terminal learning rate
settings.schedule: Continue exact Round28 terminal LR throughout additional10000; preserve latest aligned model, moments and RNG, no restart
settings.validationStatus: Previously exposed development sources; not independent unseen validation
settings.batching: Conditional length buckets64/128/256; same marginal row probabilities, correlated batch lengths; no target truncation. Different update trajectory from unbucketed pilots.

validation.metric: Weighted segmentation diagnostic; not probability of independent text
